lessons_used: Evidence remains thin for most change types, as only adoption new_flow, choose_path copy, finish new_screen, home new_flow, and sign_in hint have been tested at least twice.
choose_path copy and finish new_screen changes consistently showed no clear effect across all completed tests.
home new_flow and sign_in hint are helpful change types that delivered wins, though some tests showed no clear effect.
adoption new_flow can be helpful, but most tests (3 out of 4) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but consistently underestimated results for home new_flow.

candidates.title: Existing Account Pet Recovery Callout
candidates.change: Add a clear account sync hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing into their existing account restores previously created pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign_in hints have proven to be an effective change type.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your original account to automatically restore all your saved desktop pets.

guard.reason: Adding account restoration hint on sign-in screen is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High support volume (8 emails) and sign_in hints are proven effective (+1.9%). Quick copy update.

candidates.title: Live Desktop Pet Generation Status Flow
candidates.change: Rebuild the waiting screen with a staged layout featuring real-time rendering progress updates and interactive tips.
candidates.why: Home wait step has a median duration of 201s, and past lessons highlight home new_flow changes as consistently strong performers.

guard.reason: 'waiting.components[0].label' must be text up to 40 characters

candidates.title: Split Layout Customization Workspace
candidates.change: Redesign the companion pick screen into a split workspace layout separating companion selection choices from live pet preview components.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops to 63.3% conversion, and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visuals.

guard.reason: Split layout for pick_friend screen maintains the selection functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has high dropoff (36.7%), but redesigns require high effort with uncertain historical lift.

candidates.title: Desktop Companion Interaction Onboarding Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated onboarding screen prior to completion that demonstrates basic desktop pet controls, hiding shortcuts, and interaction commands.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails noted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or converse with their desktop pet.

new_controls_intro.headline: Mastering Your Desktop Companion
new_controls_intro.body: Right-click your pet anytime to access controls, send commands, or adjust visibility options.

guard.reason: Adding a controls intro screen before home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high loss, but finish new_screen consistently showed no clear effect across tests.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Sign-In Journey Reorder
candidates.change: Move sign-in after pet adoption and customization screens so users establish emotional investment before account setup.
candidates.why: Moving account sign-in after pet selection leverages high adoption intent to reduce onboarding churn.

guard.reason: Reordering sign_in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Previous sign_in reorder test resulted in negative lift (-1.4%), lacks support mail backing.

candidates.title: Pet Preparation Time Remaining Estimate
candidates.change: Display dynamic time remaining estimates and completion notifications during the desktop pet assembly process.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s, causing user drop-off if time expectations are unclear.

waiting.hint: Your desktop companion is being prepared. Estimated time: ~2 minutes.

guard.reason: text in 'waiting.hint' has characters outside the allowed set: ['~']

candidates.title: Spotlight Companion Path Selector
candidates.change: Update the path selection screen to a spotlight layout focusing attention on one companion onboarding journey at a time.
candidates.why: Choose path mean duration is 514s despite an 8s median, indicating some users experience choice paralysis.

guard.reason: Updating choose_path screen layout is an allowed onboarding design change.

candidates.score_note: High mean time indicates confusion, and layout change showed +1.8% in single test.

candidates.title: Clear Photo Upload Requirement Instructions
candidates.change: Provide clear copy on photo upload guidelines explaining lighting and framing for accurate pet model generation.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or yielding distorted pet visual results.

upload_photos.headline: Upload Clear Pet Photos for Best Results
upload_photos.body: Use well-lit, front-facing photos so our system can accurately render your custom desktop pet model.

guard.reason: Adding photo upload guidelines copy is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest dropoff step (adoption) backed by 3 support tickets, low implementation cost.

candidates.title: First Day Companion Interaction Reward Callout
candidates.change: Add an interactive reward badge on the final intro screen encouraging immediate first desktop interaction.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8%, and users report uncertainty on what to do immediately after onboarding.

components.text: Click your pet on the desktop to claim your starter toy!

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions gifts or free extras ('starter toy').

candidates.title: Background Pet Spawn Ready Desktop Alert
candidates.change: Enable desktop readiness notifications on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while pet generation completes.
candidates.why: The generation phase takes hundreds of seconds, and 3 users filed tickets when pets failed to show up on screen immediately.

waiting.hint: Feel free to work on other tasks. We will alert you when your pet lands on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding desktop readiness notifications to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home step has lower total dropoff, but long wait times and support tickets justify notification alert.

picked: Background Pet Spawn Ready Desktop Alert

decisions.title: Background Pet Spawn Ready Desktop Alert

lessons_next: Evidence remains thin for most change kinds, as only adoption new_flow, choose_path copy, choose_path layout, finish new_screen, home new_flow, and sign_in hint have at least two tests.
choose_path copy and finish new_screen changes did not work, showing no clear effect or worse performance across all tests.
home new_flow, sign_in hint, choose_path layout, and adoption new_flow can be helpful change types since each produced at least one winning test, though several tests showed no clear effect.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but consistently underestimated results for home new_flow.
